nodes.name: Webhook: Invoice Received
nodes.notes: Receives draft invoices from billing systems (Stripe, QuickBooks, etc). Expected payload: { config_id, invoice_id, account_name, line_item, billed_unit_price, quantity, remarks? }

nodes.name: Webhook: Pricing Update
nodes.notes: Receives agreed pricing from CRM or sales tools. Expected payload: { config_id, account_name, line_item, agreed_unit_price, source_reference?, remarks?, entered_by? }

nodes.name: Scheduled Check (Hourly)
nodes.notes: Fallback: runs the comparison hourly even if no webhook fired. Catches anything entered manually via dashboard.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO webhook_log (config_id, source, payload) VALUES ('{{ $json.config_id }}', 'billing_webhook', '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb); INSERT INTO draft_invoices (config_id, invoice_id, account_name, line_item, billed_unit_price, quantity, remarks, entry_method) VALUES ('{{ $json.config_id }}', '{{ $json.invoice_id }}', '{{ $json.account_name }}', '{{ $json.line_item }}', {{ $json.billed_unit_price }}, {{ $json.quantity || 1 }}, {{ $json.remarks ? "'" + $json.remarks + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'webhook');

nodes.name: Store Draft Invoice
nodes.notes: Logs the raw webhook payload AND inserts the draft invoice in one step.

parameters.query: INSERT INTO webhook_log (config_id, source, payload) VALUES ('{{ $json.config_id }}', 'crm_pricing_webhook', '{{ JSON.stringify($json) }}'::jsonb); INSERT INTO agreed_pricing (config_id, account_name, line_item, agreed_unit_price, source_reference, remarks, entered_by, entry_method) VALUES ('{{ $json.config_id }}', '{{ $json.account_name }}', '{{ $json.line_item }}', {{ $json.agreed_unit_price }}, {{ $json.source_reference ? "'" + $json.source_reference + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.remarks ? "'" + $json.remarks + "'" : 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.entered_by ? "'" + $json.entered_by + "'" : 'NULL' }}, 'webhook');

nodes.name: Store Agreed Pricing
nodes.notes: Logs the raw webhook payload AND inserts the agreed pricing record.

parameters.query: SELECT id, business_name, mismatch_tolerance, alert_channel, alert_destination FROM client_configs LIMIT 1;

SELECT di.id AS draft_id, di.invoice_id, di.account_name, di.line_item, di.billed_unit_price, di.quantity, di.remarks AS invoice_remarks, ap.id AS agreed_id, ap.agreed_unit_price, ap.source_reference, ap.remarks AS pricing_remarks, ap.entered_by, ABS(di.billed_unit_price - COALESCE(ap.agreed_unit_price, 0)) AS deviation, CASE WHEN ap.id IS NULL THEN 'unmatched' WHEN ABS(di.billed_unit_price - ap.agreed_unit_price) <= {{ $json.mismatch_tolerance }} THEN 'clean' ELSE 'flagged' END AS check_result FROM draft_invoices di LEFT JOIN agreed_pricing ap ON di.config_id = ap.config_id AND LOWER(TRIM(di.account_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(ap.account_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM(di.line_item)) = LOWER(TRIM(ap.line_item)) AND (ap.effective_until IS NULL OR ap.effective_until >= di.invoice_date) WHERE di.config_id = '{{ $json.id }}' AND di.status = 'pending_review';

INSERT INTO mismatch_log (config_id, draft_invoice_id, agreed_pricing_id, account_name, line_item, agreed_price, billed_price, deviation, match_status) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Client Config').item.json.id }}', '{{ $json.draft_id }}', {{ $json.agreed_id ? "'" + $json.agreed_id + "'" : 'NULL' }}, '{{ $json.account_name }}', '{{ $json.line_item }}', {{ $json.agreed_unit_price || 'NULL' }}, {{ $json.billed_unit_price }}, {{ $json.deviation }}, '{{ $json.check_result }}');
UPDATE draft_invoices SET status = '{{ $json.check_result }}' WHERE id = '{{ $json.draft_id }}';

INSERT INTO run_log (config_id, total_invoices_checked, clean_count, flagged_count, unmatched_count) VALUES ('{{ $('Load Client Config').item.json.id }}', {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'clean').length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'flagged').length }}, {{ $('Compare: Billed vs Agreed').all().filter(i => i.json.check_result === 'unmatched').length }});
